top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Listed (26 TAC §HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - No)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Regular care is being provided to 2 unrelated children.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director has not been present at the operation for at least 30% or 75% of the time.

top_violation_types.title: Exemptions for Immunization Requirements Must Meet Criteria Specified by DSHS (26 TAC §746.615(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of inspection, one child did not have proof of exemption for immunizations in their file.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Out of ten files reviewed, four staff members did not have Pre-Service training available for review at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The center director does not have proof of having completed orientation on file.

top_violation_types.title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is not notifying parents of less serious injuries.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.
